description: This file defines the StatusResponse class, which encapsulates the status information including execution and waiting flags, along with diagnostics data, within the Orleans runtime messaging system.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: A sealed class representing the status response with flags for execution and waiting states, and diagnostics information.

methods.name: StatusResponse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the status flags based on execution and waiting states, and sets diagnostics.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides Object.ToString() to provide a string representation of the status response.
